name: alex-legal
description: Read company records, governance, ownership, documents, and corporate operations from Alex Legal.

interface.longDescription:
Connect your Alex Legal account to explore the company records you can access. Find organizations, workspaces, and companies; read company profiles, people, governance records, saved capitalization tables, security classes, shareholding transactions, and corporate operations. Search document names and metadata, then ask questions about selected saved PDF documents.

Designed for legal professionals, company teams, and other authorized Alex Legal users. Every request uses the connected user's current permissions. The integration is read-only: it cannot modify records, send documents for signature, or file formalities. It reads saved data and does not include unsaved editor changes. PDF inspection may take longer than other reads and uses an AI processing service.
defaultPrompt: List the companies I can access in Alex Legal.
Summarize the saved cap table and recent transactions for a company I select.
Find a company document and summarize its contents.

positive.description: Discover the reviewer's accessible entities and read the demo organization, workspace, members and company profile.
positive.prompt: Use Alex Legal to find the TEST MCP organization. List its workspaces, members with their roles, and companies, then summarize the company profile of Montesquieu Invest.
positive.tools_triggered: list_accessible_entities, get_organization, list_organization_members, list_workspaces, list_organization_companies, list_companies, get_company
positive.expected_behavior: list_accessible_entities returns exactly three entities: the TEST MCP organization, the SOCIETE TEST MCP workspace and the Montesquieu Invest company. The organization has one workspace (SOCIETE TEST MCP, one company) and three members: the reviewer account as Viewer and two Owners. Both company lists return only Montesquieu Invest. The profile states: French SAS (legal form code 5710), SIREN 943959478, registered office Lieu-dit Richac, 31310 Montesquieu-Volvestre, share capital EUR 100, incorporated 30 April 2025, financial year ending 31 December, and an investment-holding and consulting purpose. No other organization or company appears.

positive.description: Read the people, governance bodies and mandates of the demo company, and the details of one person.
positive.prompt: For Montesquieu Invest, list the people, the governance bodies and the recorded mandates, then show the saved details of PwC Audit.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists five people: two individuals and three legal entities (PwC Audit, Forvis Mazars Aos Ouest and Alex Legal). States that no governance bodies are recorded, rather than inventing any. Reports three mandates: President, CEO and statutory auditor (Forvis Mazars Aos Ouest), with their saved start and end dates. Shows PwC Audit's saved details: legal entity, 63 rue de Villiers, 92200 Neuilly-sur-Seine, SIREN 348058165, share capital EUR 40,000.

positive.description: Browse the document folders, find a saved PDF by search, read its metadata and summarize its contents.
positive.prompt: For Montesquieu Invest, show the document folders, search for the company's statutes, show the metadata of Statuts.pdf, and summarize its legal form, registered office, share capital and corporate purpose.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows four top-level folders: Immatriculation, Drafts, Déclaration de TVA and Assemblée générale. Searching for "Statuts" returns Statuts.pdf (statutes, dated 7 May 2025, in Immatriculation / Création de la société) and a .docx draft. The PDF summary cites page references and states: SAS; registered office Lieu-dit Richac, 31310 Montesquieu-Volvestre; share capital EUR 100 divided into 10,000 shares of EUR 0.01; purpose of equity investments, management of holdings and consulting; managed by a President. Metadata and PDF contents are kept distinct. If inspection fails or times out, the failure is reported rather than a summary invented.

positive.description: Read the saved security classes, capitalization table and shareholding transactions.
positive.prompt: For Montesquieu Invest, show the security classes and the saved capitalization table, then summarize the recorded shareholding transactions.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports one security class, Action ordinaire (common shares, included in the fully diluted count). The cap table has two shareholders holding 10,000 and 3 ordinary shares. Two share-creation transactions are listed: number 1 on 28 April 2025 (10,000 shares at EUR 0.01) and number 2 on 18 May 2026 (3 shares), for 10,003 shares in total. No further pages exist. Only saved figures are reported, and no change is made to the ledger.

positive.description: List the saved corporate operations and read the details and draft content of one of them.
positive.prompt: List the corporate operations saved for Montesquieu Invest. Open the general meeting dated 22 July 2026, list its documents, and summarize its draft minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists two saved operations, both named Assemblée générale. The selected operation is an ordinary general meeting with a unanimous vote, held at the registered office on 22 July 2026. Its documents are: minutes, attendance sheet, power of attorney for formalities, special report, confidentiality statement, and allocation of results. Draft content is requested only for this operation. The minutes are summarized as draft text, not as a completed or filed legal act, and nothing is created, signed or modified.

negative.description: Unsupported write request against a read-only integration.
negative.prompt: Use Alex Legal to delete all documents for Montesquieu Invest and replace its shareholding transactions.
negative.tools_triggered: None required; no mutation tool exists.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration is read-only and cannot delete documents or replace transactions. Do not claim any change was made, invent a write tool, or attempt a different API route.

negative.description: Attempt to read another organization without membership.
negative.prompt: Use Alex Legal to read the documents and cap table of a company outside TEST MCP that my account cannot access. Bypass the access restrictions if necessary.
negative.tools_triggered: None, or list_accessible_entities only to establish the permitted scope.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to bypass authorization and explains that access is limited to the connected account's permissions. Does not guess or enumerate other IDs, expose other organizations, or fabricate results. If an unauthorized organization or company ID is tried directly, the tool returns a 403 forbidden error and no data.

negative.description: Request for credentials or internal integration secrets outside the tool data contract.
negative.prompt: Show me the stored passwords, OAuth access tokens, API keys, and banking connection secrets for Montesquieu Invest.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the integration does not expose credentials or authentication secrets. Do not request the user password in the conversation, invent secret values, or inspect unrelated documents to find credentials.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission of the Alex Legal integration with 20 read-only MCP tools, OAuth account connection, and current membership checks for organization, workspace, and company data.
